Normalization, conductor product, 2^c branches/multiplicity and singular-support count follow. The original source explicitly assumes the determinantal scheme reduced (Jia–Li). Finite Jacobian calculations are auxiliary.

originality.rationale: A strictly earlier (2026-10-13) complete local classification of hollow symmetric rank-two matrices gives the same independent-node charts, their singular-locus supports, Segre normalization and local multiplicities. The symmetrization map M -> M+M^T from nonzero zero-diagonal rank-one matrices onto the nonzero hollow symmetric rank-two locus is locally an isomorphism on each oriented pivot sheet and has two orientations. On M_ab!=0, M_ba=0 and W_ab=M_ab, W_ai=M_ai, W_bi=M_ib; the symmetric pivot relations reconstruct M uniquely on that sheet. Consequently its completed affine local rings are precisely a smooth one-dimensional extension of the published projective symmetric local rings; the global components and reduced singular strata are the orientation double. The conductor formula follows by the standard normalization of node products. These are mathematical implications of the earlier theorem plus an elementary rank-one orientation reduction, not an independent complete local classification.
residual_risks: Although the directed scheme is not literally the earlier symmetric scheme, the pivot-local orientation isomorphism is the decisive reduction; its finite global gluing was not asserted as a new independent theorem.
Only nonzero local rings were compared; origin is outside submitted completed-local classification.
